messages:
clare: quick UX callout — on narrow view the token breakdown pushes the invoice CTA offscreen. i'm wondering if a floating panel that overlays the chart would be better than inline expansion. thoughts?

 tom: float sounds promising. overlay keeps CTA visible. need to ensure it doesn't obscure important chart points.

 ana: accessibility: overlays must be modal for keyboard users (trap focus) and announced. we should use aria-modal and role=dialog with a clear title like 'Token breakdown details'.

 keith: engineering note: overlay as a lightweight panel is ok. we can reuse SlideOver component. prefer slide-from-right on desktop and full-screen on mobile. add focus return to the trigger when closed.

 sana: copy nit: overlay header should show current scope and rollup mode: e.g., "Token breakdown — Org: Acme Corp — Monthly". also include a visible close button with label "Close token breakdown".

 designbot: mock uploaded: https://assets.redwood/screencap/float-panel-v1.png (slideOver, close btn).

 clare: CSS consideration: add subtle backdrop blur and dim to indicate modal. ensure backdrop has 4.5:1 contrast for focusable elements.

 tom: for metrics, make opening overlay a distinct analytic event so we can track usage vs inline. event: ledger.breakdown.open (method=overlay).

 keith: will implement with SlideOver, aria-modal, focus trap, and analytics. ETA 48hrs. I'll behind FF `breakdown_overlay_v1`.

 ana: QA checklist: 1) SR reads dialog title, 2) focus lands in panel, 3) Escape closes and returns focus, 4) panel announced on open.

 clare: perfect — let's try this overlay behind flag and compare engagement to inline expansion. thanks all :sparkles:
